cohort: Deliveries after 24 weeks of gestation with LCMs at a tertiary-care referral centre in North India over one year.
finding: Anencephaly, severe meningomyelocele, multicystic dysplastic kidneys, and non-immune hydrops with major cardiac defects were the most prevalent LCMs, and these were more common in mothers who were 20-35 years old, illiterate, of middle/lower socioeconomic class, multigravida, and those who had no detailed anomaly scan.
